propositions: test_full_backend_account_is_present fails deterministically on hosts with scc or lizard installed because metric tool resolution succeeds but the below-threshold fixture yields no metric match record
the test asserts metric backend presence without controlling optional tool availability, leaving reconstruction host-dependent
the sibling test test_metric_backend_skip_is_reconstructable already uses explicit _METRIC_CANDIDATES fixture control to force missing-tool behavior and should be replicated in the full-account test
forcing _METRIC_CANDIDATES to a missing executable makes the test emit the expected skipped/no_tool coverage record deterministically on all hosts
production grounding behavior must remain unchanged: a successful tool run with no threshold match must not fabricate a match or abstain record
